services.name: Two-Hour Private Day Sail
services.desc: Enjoy the breezes and fresh, clear waters on your own private sailing cruise! Our 37ft sailing vessel will be crewed for you by a licensed captain and mate offering exceptional first class hospitality! Please call for last-minute availability Rates Private Charter | Up to 6 Guests!: Starting at $299 All Ages Duration 2 Hours About Our two hour sails consist of a breathtaking cruise through West Grand Traverse Bay. Grand Traverse Bay allows for calm waters and a relaxing atmosphere. includes cork service for wine brought on board. What to Bring Beverages or drinks. We can provide bottle water, cups for your drinks and ice will be aboard. What to Wear Sunscreen and a hat. Please no spray

services.name: Private Sunset Sail
services.desc: Enjoy a beautiful Leelanau sunset, feel the breezes on your skin, and watch the sun and clouds paint the sky – This year, do something different! Our 37ft sailing vessel will be crewed for you by a licensed captain and mate offering exceptional first class hospitality! Please call for last-minute availability Rates Private Charter | Up to 6 Guests!: Starting at $339 All Ages Duration 2 Hours About Sunset is the most magical time on Grand Traverse Bay. The winds turn calm and the sun paints the sky into beautiful scenery. Our Sunset sail will leave you relaxed and feeling pure happiness. Come share this experience with us as if on your own private yacht. includes cork service for your wine

services.name: Cherry Festival Air Show
services.desc: Cruise West Bay and enjoy watching the Air Show from the BEST PERSPECTIVE POSSIBLE! Rates Private Charter | Up to 6 Guests!: $599 All Ages Duration 3.5 Hours About Saturday, June 29th and Sunday June 30th, 2024 Get the up-close view of the annual Cherry Festival Air show. You swear they are going to hit the mast, they are that low. The show starts at 1pm, book your sail now!! Price includes cork service for wine brought onboard. What to Bring Visor or sun hat with a cap Sunglasses Sport shoes or sandals Sweater or jacket (the temperature on the water can be 10 to 20 degrees cooler than on land) Bathing suit Lunch and snack (we supply a cooler and ice) Your favorite
